name: Watanabe Takafumi
source:
Star Sign: Scorpio

A business man that works in trading company that is close to La Crima.
After he got divorced from his wife he is left taking care of their young daughter [url=/c41767]Rimi[/url] as a single father, but because he is awkward around his daughter he is worried that his ex-wife [url=/c41764]Yukie[/url] will want to take custody of her.
The protagonist helped Rimi when she was lost and they got acquainted and he became charmed by the protagonist's bright personality.
